offers_products.reason: Manufactures pulse oximetry sensors, Root monitoring platform, SedLine brain monitors and other medical devices.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from devices, sensors and software; no main service offering beyond support tied to products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Products are clinical monitors and sensors sold to hospitals and clinicians; the consumer audio business is gone.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Hospitals, health systems, and OEM partners buy its patient monitors and sensors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largely repeat purchases of disposable and reusable sensors for installed monitors, plus service and software.

cyclical_demand.reason: Hospitals need patient monitoring and sensors for care regardless of the economy; consumables are essential.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly disposable sensors and monitors bought repeatedly; individual sensor sales are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from manufactured devices, sensors and monitoring technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are hospitals and health systems, plus large OEM partners; now part of Danaher.

asset_heavy.reason: Develops and manufactures sensors and monitors; typical medtech manufacturing, not plants, fleets or networks-heavy.

notes: Website says Masimo is now part of Danaher; consumer audio business (Sound United) was sold, so it is excluded.
